name: Defias Hideout
summary: Vagrants and Defias thugs linger in the ruined house on Moonbrook’s southern edge. Its upper floor conceals a route into chambers beneath the town.

sections.title: A Gateway in Ruin
sections.body:
Edwin VanCleef’s southern operations lie beneath a ruined house in Moonbrook. Vagrants and Defias thugs move through its ransacked rooms, much like those in other manors and farmhouses in the settlement. On the upper floor, an opening descends into the winding passages of the Deadmines.

The Brotherhood keeps most of its strength around Moonbrook’s perimeter and at work underground, leaving few guards inside. They watch the hideout as a narrow passage into the mines, not as a stronghold of its own.

faq.q: What is inside the Defias Hideout?
faq.answer: A staircase inside the house leads to a winding tunnel and the overland entrance to the Deadmines. Vagrants wander through the mostly bare building, with a few bandits nearby.

faq.q: Why is the hideout relatively unguarded inside?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood keeps its fighters in Moonbrook’s streets to intercept intruders. Its laborers and enforcers work deep in the mines.

faq.q: Where in Moonbrook is this building located?
faq.answer: The hideout stands on Moonbrook’s southern edge in southwestern Westfall, near the base of the mountains. It is a large, intact, two-story building.

faq.q: Who are the people lingering around the hideout?
faq.answer: Defias bandits and desperate vagrants linger in the building and around Moonbrook. Some vagrants fled poverty; others joined the Brotherhood out of necessity.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can see how the Defias conceal a gateway to a vast underground fortress inside a plain ruined manor. Its scale stays hidden from casual Stormwind patrols.
As an Alliance adventurer, you can trace Edwin VanCleef’s conspiracy to this crumbling estate. It is a key staging ground in the effort to end the Defias rebellion.
